{{Top|leg}}
The '''magnetic railgun''' was a massive type of artillery weapon developed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to be utilized in surface-to-vacuum combat. This [[Railgun/Legends|railgun]] used powerful magnetic systems to launch projectiles into [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. There were many of this weapon type placed on the surface of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].
